draft.emotion: a relaxed, unhurried afternoon with no specific obligations or pressure
notes: The opposite is 바쁘다 (busy) for people or time, and 붐비다 or 복잡하다 (crowded) for places.
Unlike 심심하다 (bored), which means wanting something interesting to do, 한가하다 simply means having free time or few people around and often feels relaxing.
